# Aryan Khamar

> Freelance full-stack developer based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India, available remotely worldwide. Co-founder of CookOnCall. Builds web products and internal business software with Next.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL, and does QA for live platforms. Open to freelance projects and contract work, remotely, for clients in the United States, the UK and Europe, the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), Australia and across India (Ahmedabad, Mumbai and other cities).

## Work

- [Shop'n Earn](https://shopnearn.in): part-time freelance QA engineer for an e-commerce platform with wallets and referral payouts (Oct 2026 to present).
- AlgoVista Analytics: AI/ML Engineer Intern, automation department (23 Feb to 25 Mar 2026).
